35672-gloria-victis-a-romance.title: A Romance
35672-gloria-victis-a-romance.creator: Ossip Schubin
35672-gloria-victis-a-romance.description: A book by Ossip Schubin. The short after-season which, like an echo of the carnival, is wont to follow Lent, that holy intermezzo crowded with charity-bazaars, musical soirées and other elegant penitential observances, is rather duller than usual this year. Easter came too late and although _Figaro_ continues its daily record of balls and routs, Paris takes very little heed.

arxiv-2104-00073.title: FAPIS: A Few-shot Anchor-free Part-based Instance Segmenter
arxiv-2104-00073.creator: Khoi Nguyen and Sinisa Todorovic Oregon State University Corvallis, OR 97330, USA {nguyenkh,sinisa}@oregonstate.edu
arxiv-2104-00073.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Khoi Nguyen and Sinisa Todorovic Oregon State University Corvallis, OR 97330, USA {nguyenkh,sinisa}@oregonstate.edu. This paper is about few-shot instance segmentation, where training and test image sets do not share the same object classes. We specify and evaluate a new few-shot anchor-free part-based instance segmenter (FAPIS). Our key novelty is in explicit modeling of latent object parts shared across training object classes, which is expected to facilitate our few-shot learning on new classes in testing.

arxiv-2104-09838.title: Sparse Sliced Inverse Regression via Cholesky Matrix Penalization
arxiv-2104-09838.creator: Linh H. Nghiem, Francis K.C.Hui, Samuel Müller, A.H. Welsh
arxiv-2104-09838.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Linh H. Nghiem, Francis K.C.Hui, Samuel Müller, A.H. Welsh. Abstract: We introduce a new sparse sliced inverse regression estimator called Cholesky matrix penalization and its adaptive version for achieving sparsity in estimating the dimensions of the central subspace. The new estimators use the Cholesky decomposition of the covariance matrix of the covariates and include a regularization term in the objective function to achieve sparsity in a computationally efficient manner.

arxiv-2202-03169.title: CITRIS: Causal Identifiability from Temporal Intervened Sequences
arxiv-2202-03169.creator: Phillip Lippe, Sara Magliacane, Sindy Löwe, Yuki M. Asano, Taco Cohen, Efstratios Gavves
arxiv-2202-03169.description: Abstract Understanding the latent causal factors of a dynamical system from visual observations is considered a crucial step towards agents reasoning in complex environments. In this paper, we propose CITRIS, a variational autoencoder framework that learns causal representations from temporal sequences of images in which underlying causal factors have possibly been intervened upon.

arxiv-2206-05053.title: Coswara: A website application enabling COVID-19 screening by analysing respiratory sound samples and health symptoms
arxiv-2206-05053.creator: Debarpan Bhattacharya, Debottam Dutta, Neeraj Kumar Sharma, Srikanth Raj Chetupalli, Pravin Mote, Sriram Ganapathy, Chandrakiran C, Sahiti Nori, Suhail K K, Sadhana Gonuguntla, Murali Alagesan
arxiv-2206-05053.description: Abstract The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated research on design of alternative, quick and effective COVID-19 diagnosis approaches. In this paper, we describe the Coswara tool, a website application designed to enable COVID-19 detection by analysing respiratory sound samples and health symptoms.

arxiv-2208-12222.title: Precise predictions and new insights for atomic ionisation from the Migdal effect
arxiv-2208-12222.creator: Peter Cox, Matthew J. Dolan, Christopher McCabe, Harry M. Quiney
arxiv-2208-12222.description: Abstract The scattering of neutral particles by an atomic nucleus can lead to electronic ionisation and excitation through a process known as the Migdal effect. We revisit and improve upon previous calculations of the Migdal effect, using the Dirac-Hartree-Fock method to calculate the atomic wavefunctions.

arxiv-2305-00597.title: Incremental procedural and sensorimotor learning in cognitive humanoid robots Thanks: This work was developed within the scope of PPI-Softex with support from MCTI through the Technical Cooperation Term [01245.013778/2020-21]. Thanks: A. S. Simões and L. L. Rossi are with Dept. of Control and Automa
arxiv-2305-00597.creator: Leonardo de Lellis Rossi, Letícia Mara Berto, Eric Rohmer, Paula Paro Costa
arxiv-2305-00597.description: Abstract The ability to automatically learn movements and behaviors of increasing complexity is a long-term goal in autonomous systems. Indeed, this is a very complex problem that involves understanding how knowledge is acquired and reused by humans as well as proposing mechanisms that allow artificial agents to reuse previous knowledge.

arxiv-2308-07733.title: Dynamic Low-Rank Instance Adaptation for Universal Neural Image Compression Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29–November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada. Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29–Novembe
arxiv-2308-07733.creator: Yue Lv, Jinxi Xiang, Jun Zhang, Wenming Yang, Xiao Han, Wei Yang
arxiv-2308-07733.description: Abstract . The latest advancements in neural image compression show great potential in surpassing the rate-distortion performance of conventional standard codecs. Nevertheless, there exists an indelible domain gap between the datasets utilized for training (i.e., natural images) and those utilized for inference (e.g., artistic images).

arxiv-2406-14831.title: Verifying Hierarchic Multipartite and Network Nonlocalities with a Unified Method
arxiv-2406-14831.creator: Ming-Xing Luo, Shao-Ming Fei
arxiv-2406-14831.description: Abstract The multipartite nonlocality provides deep insights into the fundamental feature of quantum mechanics and guarantees different degrees of cryptography security for potential applications in the quantum internet. Verifying multipartite nonlocal correlations is a difficult task. We propose a unified approach that encompasses all the quantum characteristics of the multipartite correlated system beyond from fully separable to biseparable no-signaling correlations.

arxiv-2407-20349.title: Legendre transforms for type A n A_{n} and B n B_{n} ∨ \vee -systems
arxiv-2407-20349.creator: Misha Feigin, Leo Kaminski, Ian A.B. Strachan
arxiv-2407-20349.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Misha Feigin, Leo Kaminski, Ian A.B. Strachan. The Witten–Dijkgraaf–Verlinde–Verlinde (WDVV) equations have a rich structure related to the theory of Frobenius manifolds, with many known families of solutions. A Legendre transformation is a symmetry of the WDVV equations, introduced by Dubrovin. We explicitly compute the results of a Legendre transformation applied to A n A_{n} - and B n B_{n} -type multi-parameter rational solutions, relating them to known and new trigonometric solutions.

arxiv-2410-07140.title: DSparsE: Dynamic Sparse Embedding for Knowledge Graph Completion
arxiv-2410-07140.creator: Chuhong Yang, Bin Li, Nan Wu
arxiv-2410-07140.description: Abstract Addressing the incompleteness problem in knowledge graph remains a significant challenge. Current knowledge graph completion methods have their limitations. For example, ComDensE is prone to overfitting and suffers from the degradation with the increase of network depth while InteractE has the limitations in feature interaction and interpretability.

arxiv-2501-06885.title: The impact of intraband carrier dynamics on the optical properties of two-dimensional materials: I. General theory
arxiv-2501-06885.creator: A.O. Slobodeniuk, T. Novotný
arxiv-2501-06885.description: Abstract We consider the generation of microscopic polarization in two-dimensional semiconductors under intense optical fields in the non-resonant regime. We demonstrate that the intraband motion of quasiparticles, driven by the electric field of the laser pulse, contributes substantially to the system’s polarization. The effects of intraband motion are analyzed using the semiconductor Bloch equations.

arxiv-2501-11427.title: Defaultable bond liquidity spread estimation: an option-based approach
arxiv-2501-11427.creator: Pietro Rossi, Paolo Spezzati, Riccardo Tedeschi
arxiv-2501-11427.description: Abstract This paper extends an option-theoretic approach to estimate liquidity spreads for corporate bonds. Inspired by Longstaff’s equity market framework and subsequent work by Koziol and Sauerbier on risk-free zero-coupon bonds, the model views liquidity as a look-back option. The model accounts for the interplay of risk-free rate volatility and credit risk.

arxiv-2512-06508.title: Convective Viscous Cahn-Hilliard/Allen-Cahn Equation with memory effects
arxiv-2512-06508.creator: P. O. Mchedlov-Petrosyan, L. N. Davydov
arxiv-2512-06508.description: Abstract The combination of the well-known Cahn-Hilliard and Allen-Cahn equations is used to describe surface processes, such as simultaneous adsorption/desorption and surface diffusion. In the present paper we have considered the convective-viscous Cahn-Hilliard/Allen-Cahn equation complemented by memory effects. Exact solutions are obtained and the combined action of the applied field, dissipation and memory are discussed. pacs 64.60.A–, 64.60.De, 82.40.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-gregorian-cha.title: Gregorian Chant (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-gregorian-cha.creator: Henry Bewerunge
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-gregorian-cha.description: Article 'Gregorian Chant' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10707902.title: The Effect of Iron-Fortified Lentils on Blood and Cognitive Status among Adolescent Girls in Bangladesh
pmc-10707902.creator: Amy L. Barnett, Michael J. Wenger, Fakir M. Yunus, Chowdhury Jalal, Diane M. DellaValle
pmc-10707902.description: Background: Iron deficiency is highly prevalent in South Asia, especially among women and children in Bangladesh. Declines in cognitive performance are among the many functional consequences of iron deficiency. Objective: We tested the hypothesis that, over the course of a 4-month iron fortification trial, cognitive performance would improve, and that improvement would be related to improvements in iron status.

pmc-11299411.title: Comparative effectiveness of interventions for cancer treatment–related cognitive impairment in adult cancer survivors: protocol for a systematic review
pmc-11299411.creator: D M Wolfe, C Hamel, D Rice, A A Veroniki, B Skidmore, S Kanji, K Rabheru, S F McGee, L Forbes, M Liu, D Saunders, L Vandermeer, I Machado de Lima, M Clemons, B Hutton
pmc-11299411.description: BackgroundCancer treatment–related cognitive impairment (CTRCI) can substantially reduce the quality of life of cancer survivors. Many treatments of CTRCI have been evaluated in randomized controlled trials (RCTs), including psychological interventions, pharmacologic interventions, and other therapies. There is a pressing need to establish the benefits and harms of previously studied CTRCI treatments.

pmc-11342517.title: Risk factors for the time to development of retinopathy of prematurity in premature infants in Iran: a machine learning approach
pmc-11342517.creator: Leili Tapak, Leila Nezamabadi Farahani, Naeeme Taslimi Taleghani, Nazanin Ebrahimiadib, Elias Khalili Pour, Afsar Dastjani Farahani, Omid Hamidi
pmc-11342517.description: BackgroundRetinopathy of prematurity (ROP), is a preventable leading cause of blindness in infants and is a condition in which the immature retina experiences abnormal blood vessel growth. The development of ROP is multifactorial; nevertheless, the risk factors are controversial. This study aimed to identify risk factors of time to development of ROP in Iran.

pmc-11408558.title: Past body shaming experiences and food and alcohol disturbance in young adults: indirect effects via psychological distress
pmc-11408558.creator: Daniele Di Tata, Dora Bianchi, Franca Rossi, Laura Maria Fatta, Stefania Sette, Fiorenzo Laghi
pmc-11408558.description: PurposeThis study investigated the associations between retrospective reports of body image victimization (i.e. body shaming) perpetrated by peers and by parents during childhood or adolescence, and food and alcohol disturbance (FAD) in young adulthood, considering the possible mediating role of psychological distress (i.e. subthreshold symptoms of anxiety and depression).

pmc-11492175.title: Advanced High-Voltage Electrolyte Design Using Poly(ethylene Oxide) and High-Concentration Ionic Liquids for All-Solid-State Lithium-Metal Batteries
pmc-11492175.creator: Mingjie Zhang, Urbi Pal, Faezeh Makhlooghiazad, Luke A O’Dell, Shinji Kondou, Giuseppe A Elia, Claudio Gerbaldi, Maria Forsyth
pmc-11492175.description: Poly(ethylene oxide) (PEO)-based solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) are among the most promising materials for solid-state lithium metal batteries (LMBs) due to their inherent safety advantages; however, they suffer from insufficient room-temperature ionic conductivity (up to 10–6 S cm–1) and limited oxidation stability (<4 V).

pmc-11547879.title: Organic and Inorganic Modifications to Increase the Efficiency in Immobilization of Heavy Metal (Zn) in Cementitious Composites—The Impact of Cement Matrix Pore Network Characteristics
pmc-11547879.creator: Maciej Kalinowski, Karol Chilmon, Jan Bogacki, Piotr Woyciechowski
pmc-11547879.description: This research investigated the properties of modified cementitious composites including water purification from heavy metal—zinc. A new method for characterizing the immobilization properties of tested modifiers was established. Several additions had their properties investigated: biochar (BC), active carbon (AC), nanoparticulate silica (NS), copper slag (CS), iron slag (EAFIS), crushed hazelnut shells (CHS), and lightweight sintered fly ash aggregate (LSFAA).

pmc-12554227.title: Perceived racism-based police violence and substance use among black and hispanic emerging adults: Evidence from a national sample
pmc-12554227.creator: Robert O. Motley, Eric Williamson, Melissa McTernan, Sara Beeler, Christopher P. Salas-Wright
pmc-12554227.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeRacism-based police violence (RPV) is an emerging public health concern. However, limited research has examined the relationship between RPV exposure and substance use, particularly among Black or African American and Hispanic emerging adults aged 18–29 years.

pmc-12590681.title: Genetic diversity assessment and morpho-agronomic characterization of mungbean (Vigna radiata (L.) Walp.) germplasm using multivariate analysis
pmc-12590681.creator: Mohammad Irfan, M. Ashraf Bhat, Uzma Rashid, Khairah Mubarak Alwutayd, Nora M. Al Aboud, Areej S. Jalal, Z. A. Dar, Sabina Nasseer, Mohd Altaf Wani
pmc-12590681.description: The present study assessed the phenotypic and genetic diversity of 115 mungbean (Vigna radiata L.) genotypes using a combination of qualitative, quantitative, and multivariate analyses. Frequency distribution of qualitative traits revealed substantial morphological variation, with most genotypes exhibiting good early plant vigor, semi-erect plant type, indeterminate growth habit, and green reniform leaves.

pmc-12624416.title: Efficacy and Safety of Plasmapheresis in Children With Acute Transverse or Flaccid Myelitis, and Guillain‐Barré Syndrome
pmc-12624416.creator: Alix Fleurance, Laure Joseph, Laurène Dehoux, Christine Barnerias, Marie Hully, Manoelle Kossorotoff, Eugénie Sarda, Emmanuel Cheuret, Nathalie Bach, Charles De Marcellus, Florine Perez, Maxime Colmard, Pierre Meyer, Mikael Jokic, Olivia Boyer, Cyril Gitiaux, Mehdi Oualha, Isabelle Desguerre, Mélodi
pmc-12624416.description: BackgroundAcute transverse myelitis (ATM), acute flaccid myelitis with polio‐like myeloradiculitis (AFM) and Guillain‐Barré syndrome (GBS) are severe neuroimmune disorders associated with high morbidity. First‐line treatments include corticosteroids and intravenous immunoglobulins (IVIg), but they may be insufficient. Therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) and immunoadsorption (IA) are second‐ or third‐line options in pediatrics, despite their recognized efficacy in adults.

pmc-12684344.title: Artificial intelligence agents in orthopaedics: Concepts, capabilities and the road ahead
pmc-12684344.creator: Felix C. Oettl, James Pruneski, Balint Zsidai, Yinan Yu, Ting Cong, Robert Feldt, Philipp W. Winkler, Michael T. Hirschmann, Kristian Samuelsson, ESSKA Artificial Intelligence Working Group
pmc-12684344.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in orthopaedics, yet current models are often limited to narrow, isolated tasks like analysing an X‐ray or predicting a single outcome. This paper introduces AI agents—a new class of AI systems designed to overcome these limitations. Unlike traditional AI, agents can autonomously manage complex, multistep processes that mirror the complete patient journey.

pmc-12720666.title: Comparison of 2-hour versus 4-hour hemoadsorption combined with hemodialysis (HAHD): an in vitro and prospective clinical evaluation
pmc-12720666.creator: Wei Lu, Gengru Jiang
pmc-12720666.description: Although hemoadsorption combined with hemodialysis (HAHD) is increasingly used in patients undergoing maintenance hemodialysis (MHD), the optimal treatment duration remains uncertain. This study compared the efficacy and safety of 2-hour versus 4-hour HAHD sessions, supported by in vitro kinetic modeling.

pmc-12748714.title: Impact of a single swimming session on inflammatory response and iron homeostasis in adolescent female athletes during the luteal phase
pmc-12748714.creator: Marta Mydłowska, Anna Kasperska, Justyna Cichoń-Woźniak, Hanna Dziewiecka, Joanna Ostapiuk-Karolczuk, Anna Skarpańska-Stejnborn
pmc-12748714.description: The intensity and duration of physical activity significantly influence hepcidin levels, a vital hormone that manages iron balance. Its increase is associated with exercise-induced inflammation, particularly involving interleukin-6. This study explored the effect of a single swimming session on specific markers of inflammation and iron metabolism in young female athletes during the luteal phase of their menstrual cycle.

pmc-12964673.title: Ellagic acid is associated with reduced pancreatic carcinogenesis and modulation of the IL-6/STAT3 pathway
pmc-12964673.creator: Hiroyuki Kato, Aya Naiki-Ito, Masayuki Komura, Yuko Nagayasu, Motonori Sato, Xiaochen Kuang, Aya Nagano, Satoru Takahashi
pmc-12964673.description: BackgroundThe 5-year survival of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains about 10% despite therapeutic advances, underscoring the need for effective preventive and early intervention strategies. Ellagic acid (EA), a naturally occurring polyphenol, has been associated with demonstrated antitumor activity in several malignancies. However, its potential role in preventing PDAC development remains unclear.

pmc-13080992.title: Linkage Progression Mapping: Precision Structure Analysis of Individual Oligomers in Birch Milled Wood Lignin
pmc-13080992.creator: Filippa Ludvig, Åsa Emmer, Martin Lawoko
pmc-13080992.description: Molecular heterogeneity in lignin remains poorly understood due to the lack of analytics robust enough to determine the precise structure of individual molecules in isolated lignin samples. Recently, we showed that MALDI-TOF MS analysis, combined with a range of NMR techniques, facilitated comprehensive structural studies of oligomer populations present in milled wood lignin from spruce, without prior fractionation.

pmc-13294858.title: Importance of Standardizing Laboratory Medicine in a Super-aging Society
pmc-13294858.creator: Sollip Kim, Chan Ik Cho, Yeo-Min Yun, 솔잎 김, 찬익 조, 여민 윤
pmc-13294858.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesThis study aims to examine the importance of and challenges associated with chronic disease management in a super-aged society, highlight the role of laboratory medicine standardization, and propose standardization policies within the national healthcare system.MethodsThis review analyzes the necessity and importance of laboratory medicine standardization in the management of chronic diseases and standardization strategies for key laboratory medicine tests for each chronic disease.ResultsA national laboratory medicine standardization system was established, and the National Medical Reference Laboratory is currently operating within the Korea

pmc-13339629.title: Photochemistry of Sodium Pyruvate Clusters
pmc-13339629.creator: Sarah J. Madlener, Marc Reimann, Jessica C. Hartmann, Christian van der Linde, Milan Ončák, Martin K. Beyer

pmc-13471619.title: Nonsense-mediated mRNA decay: friend or foe in cancer biology?
pmc-13471619.creator: Yuhui Wang, Chenghai He, Chengyan Chen, Xin Ma, Xiyao Gao, Guodong Li, Tangliang Li
pmc-13471619.description: Nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD) is a highly conserved RNA surveillance mechanism in eukaryotic cells. It plays a key role in safeguarding the accuracy of gene expression by eliminating mRNAs with premature termination codons (PTCs) in the cellular transcriptome. Furthermore, NMD fine-tunes gene expression by regulating the stability of numerous transcripts that harbor NMD-inducing features other than PTC.

pmc-13478410.title: Enablers to successful patient and public involvement in Palliative Care Research: Qualitative perspectives of public members and Program Coordinators
pmc-13478410.creator: Mollie Wilson, Jennifer Philip, Christine Hofmeyer, Avi Paluch, Stacey Panozzo, Peter Hudson, Anna Collins
pmc-13478410.description: Background:Despite policy and health service imperatives for public involvement to be embedded within palliative care research, this practice is not commonplace. Few empirical studies have sought to explore and evaluate models of public involvement for palliative care.Aim:To explore experiences of public involvement within palliative care, and to identify enablers for successful models of involvement.Design:An exploratory qualitative design was utilized.

pmc-13573690.title: Glioblastoma recurrence: An NGS-centered seed-soil framework
pmc-13573690.creator: Jun-yi Xu, Jingxian Chen, Wenyan Feng, Guo-zhong Yi
pmc-13573690.description: Highlights•We propose an NGS-centered seed–soil framework for glioblastoma recurrence that unifies diverse observations.•The framework complements existing recurrence models rather than replacing them and remains to be experimentally validated.•Targeting NGS may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for preventing or delaying GBM recurrence.

pmc-13623218.title: Radioligand therapy for pediatric patients with solid tumors
pmc-13623218.creator: Leonor Teles, Nelleke Tolboom, Alex J Poot, Khalil Ramdhani, Sabine L A Plasschaert, Johannes H M Merks, Max M van Noesel, Arthur J A T Braat
